$chapter.source: apollo-core/src/Core/MetaRegistry.php — structured (array-of-object) post meta whose shape is nontrivial enough to need its own contract doc, starting with _dj_tracks.
$chapter.note: Structured post-meta schema contracts. _dj_tracks v2: registered 2026-07-28, both write paths (REST + admin UI) now consistent; front-end read/display path is the one remaining known_gap.

_dj_tracks.supersedes: v1 shape {title,url,year,duration} — still the ONLY shape the front-end reads, see known_gap below.

release_date.note: Y-m-d. Drives sort order and the "latest -> landing" pull.

cover_id.note: WP attachment ID, alternative to cover_url.

url_soundcloud.note: At least one of the 4 url_* fields is mandatory per row.

rest_api.note: Runs through WP's sanitize_meta(), which calls the registered sanitize_callback.

admin_metabox.note: Renders all 14 v2 fields on the Apollo dark design system (repeater_card field type, new this pass) and runs apollo_dj_sanitize_tracks_meta() as its save-time sanitize_callback — same function the REST path uses, so both surfaces enforce identical rules.

_dj_tracks.known_gap: Front-end display only: apollo_dj_get_tracks() and the out-now/out-now-lightbox/sounds templates still read the v1 shape (title/url/year/duration). A track saved via REST or the now-migrated admin metabox validates and stores correctly in v2, but will render blank on the public /dj/{id} page until the normalizer + templates are migrated to v2. Both write paths (REST, admin UI) are now fully v2 and mutually consistent — this is a read-side gap only.

duplicate_metabox_found.finding: apollo-djs' own Admin\Metabox (6 plain wp-admin boxes: info/links/tracks/gallery/booking/config) duplicated apollo-lux-panels' DjPanel field-for-field — both active simultaneously, both writing the same meta keys, with _dj_tracks specifically having TWO competing editors on one edit screen using different schemas.
duplicate_metabox_found.root_cause: apollo-lux-panels was built to supersede it (its main file even forces '#apollo_lux_panel{order:-999}' to sit above every other metabox) but the old class was never disabled.
duplicate_metabox_found.fix: Closed apollo-lux-panels' 5-field parity gap (_dj_name, _dj_statement, _dj_original_project_1..3), then guarded apollo-djs' Metabox behind class_exists('\Apollo\LuxPanels\DjPanel') in src/Plugin.php — disabled in the normal running state, falls back automatically if apollo-lux-panels is ever deactivated.
